notes.title: Version 2
notes.content: [p]Hello Job-Seekers,[/p][p][/p][p]Wow! It's been 3 whole years since we released the original Mangotronics Employment Collection, can you believe it?[/p][p]I'm so proud of all the things we've accomplished and now, I'm thrilled to be able to announce a huge update- Version 2![/p][p]With Version 2 comes new features, new games by new indie developers, and a completely overhauled launcher UI built from a new engine in a "Fake OS" style so you can organize your in-launcher game collection however you want.[/p][p]Here's what to expect in the update:[/p][list][*][p]10 new games [/p][/*][*][p]10 new devs[/p][/*][*][p]100% FREE![/p][/*][*][p]New launcher featuring Mango OS[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Deck support[/p][/*][*][p]A secret 11th game?[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Version 2 is a free content update for everyone who already owns The Mangotronics Employment Collection, bringing the total up to 19 games and demos.[/p][p]The release date will be announced as soon as we have a complete, tested and working build.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support throughout the last 3 years, and here's to an amazing 3 more![/p][p][/p][p]Welcome to the Team![/p][p]-Matt from Mangotronics[/p]

notes.title: Please Look Forward to It
notes.content: [p]Hi Everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Since the original Employment Collection released almost 3 years ago, a lot has happened: We released 2 more games, we funded our first round of indie games, and some of our friends created store pages for their new projects. [/p][p][/p][p]I hope we can help each other out and put some eyes on more games. Here's a look at some you might find interesting: [/p][p][/p][p]Games by Employment Collection alumni:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251270/Employee_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3469260/Marblous_Worlds/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The Mangotronics Fund backed games:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2962940/Rusty_Flesh/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3459330/Tire_Fire_Rally/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3266290/Wallflower/"][/dynamiclink]Keep up to date on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/johnleeerg.bsky.social"]JohnLee Cooper[/url]'s projects: [url="https://ergman.itch.io/"]https://ergman.itch.io/[/url][/p][p]Please keep an eye out for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/taylormccue"]Taylor McCue's [/url]next games in development: [url="https://taylormccue.itch.io/"]https://taylormccue.itch.io/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Games releasing this year by friends of Mangotronics:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2484580/Mushroom_Musume/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333940/ACUVAC_A_Suck_and_Blow_Adventure/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3693000/The_Last_Waltz/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We even partnered with the Ghost Town community for all future Mangotronics Fund grants, which will be jointly conducted through Ghost Town grants. [url="https://discord.gg/ghosttownhq"]https://discord.gg/ghosttownhq[/url][/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now. Thank you, and remember: Support Your Local Indies![/p]
